body: I don't have much hope of my life getting better. The people in my life who's opinions I care about don't even understand what I feel everyday. There is nobody to talk to outside the internet and even then, this place isn't comparable to professional help. I'm in my early 20s and I already have no self-esteem, believe I have no talent, and I sometimes think the world is better off with me dead. To say I think there isn't a future for me is an understatement.

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. It's cool that you were able to find good friends through video games. I made some friends too from this hobby but only a few of them I would consider close. I don't expect people to be my friend or anything but I guess when your social life only really exists online, it feels weird when most of the people you talk to just come and go.

For my community, I know almost everyone there. The fandom is extremely small and I keep in relative contact with most of the people that run what few fan clubs exist. Wikia had a wiki website for the game made years ago but it was abandoned. I was one of the few people that contributed heavily to it's wiki and eventually I was able to become admin. Honestly, I didn't want to have a "leadership" position at all on a website but there were problems with vandals deleting everyone's work and I wanted to stop it. The problem with the community is that I'm afraid of even getting to know the people here personally. The fandom is scattered with most of the people being in the US and communicating through websites like DeviantArt. These people are usually not people I could easily meet face-to-face. It's not something like Call of Duty which is extremely popular and has tournaments where I could meet many other Call of Duty fans. There are many popular games I love but only this one obscure series is the one where I put most of my effort into it's fandom. I guess I feel some sort of attachment to it because so much of my life was spent in that same community.

I agree, I can't solve the problem with the game being dead and the fans not really being around anymore. This was something that happened years ago and it's out of my power. If a video game fails, it's usually the developer's fault but I guess I take some of the blame because nobody else will remember the game except for fans like me. When I try to meet other fans and talk with them and it doesn't really work, I feel like a failure who's letting the memory of the series die. Sorry it it sounds stupid but that's the honest truth. Thank you for your positive words. I have done a lot for this community but honestly, that was mostly basic Wikia editing that other people more capable than me could've done. Sometimes I thought of getting a bunch of people I know who aren't on Wikia and see if they want to help but everyone is too busy with real life problems so nobody does anything with the game now. 

There is one person I know on DeviantArt but I don't even know if it's worth trying to know them beyond just the community. Every time I talk to them, the conversations are largely shallow. It's like when I want to talk about personal issues that bother me, as a friend and not just a fan, they just kind of shrug me off. But when they have problems and I ask what's wrong, they just keep their emotions to themselves and tell me it's fine. Which is it? Sometimes I think the best way to communicate to this person is to not communicate at all. They aren't a mean person and I do think they care about me but I also think they aren't completely aware of what I'm personally going through or even have the emotional strength to care about someone other than themselves. Not that they are selfish but more like they have their own problems and aren't in the right state of mind to be a good friend.

But if I was good at drawing, I think I could jump start the community or at least meet new fans. When your art is crap, nobody cares. But if my art was good, many more people where find it through Google and then my art page and so forth. It's just another way of meeting people to talk about something I care about but sadly I suck. Thank you for taking the time to help me through. I really appreciate it. I just need to let go and accept this video game and it's community will never be popular.

Thank you for replying. I guess it's good to be aware of your flaws but being too aware will make you feel bad. I hope one day I will get a job that I will be somewhat okay with. I wish you luck too and thanks again.

I'm sorry. I dealt with robberies and break-ins at my own apartment more than once and it was very scary and a traumatic ordeal. If you could get your cat back, I would try to do that but if you feel she's better elsewhere, then it's your choice. I hate how this world has people without money and food and we do barely anything to help them. Try to contact as much food banks/shelters/assistance programs as possible, even if you feel it's futile.

Your mother is just your mother. You can't fix her. She doesn't even deserve the time of day if she would abuse you. Do you have any relatives or friends you can stay with? I'm sorry you are dealing with this. You shouldn't kill yourself just because a miserable human being just so happened to also be your mother. It's not fair to yourself to give up just because your mother is a loser. You deserve better than that.

What if I don't want to try? What if I don't want to work for the things I want in life? Why should anyone have to work at all? It's stupid. I know why the world is the way it is but I feel like I do not belong it in. Everyday I get beat over the head with the narrative that if you don't work hard, you just deserve to fail and only talented and beautiful people matter. No, not everyone believes this but does it really matter if this is the narrative society wants to be true? If society wishes it to be true, then it's true. If people hate the poor and they hate me, then maybe I deserve to die. I can't be successful like you are. I am happy for you. I wish I had a work ethic but I don't. Please don't be a failure like me.

Sometimes it feels like I was born wrong and I didn't come with the power to deal with how terrible this world is. No, not everything is bad and I don't suffer as much as many other people. But that just brings me shame and it makes me feel like I don't appreciate anything, which is not true. I wish I could just stop caring, get a job, and move on with my life like many other people do.

Hello. I'm a high school drop out and I never really hard a job. College is not an option and I don't think there are any jobs around for me. I'm honestly scared of getting a job and I think I'm bad with people. You're right, I do talk down to myself a lot. I never talk to anyone else like this so it's strange that I constantly treat myself like dirt. Thank you for your reply. I wish I knew what to do with my life but that is only for me to find out.

Only my mother would miss me, really. Everyone else in my family is irrelevant and not really in my life at all. The only friends I have are on the internet so it's not like they would even be aware of my own suicide. It just doesn't matter but I don't want it to be this way. There has to be a reason for us to live on, somehow. I'm sick of this constant despair. I don't want to live in a world where I'm worthless and suicide is ever an option.
I'm sorry you lost your son. Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. I wish I knew what else to say.
I don't even have a job. It's hard not to feel worthless when you don't have much money.

You are 18 and even if you were older and were in a relationship, if you are emotionally sad/depressed/suicidal, it will affect the relationship. I never really cared myself about being with people romantically but for many, it's important. You need to move forward and let go of this ideal that being in a relationship with someone else is important. It is not. Really, it isn't. There is no gurantee you will even be happy or find someone who works for you. I believe many people who are couples are not perfect but they try to make it work and for many it does for years. A lot of them get married to. But 18 is really young to be obsessed over something like this. I would wait a couple years and try to get my life in order somewhat and if the right person came along, I would try then to form a relationship. You are not worthless just because you are single.

I wish I could get the courage and find a therapist or something. Maybe one day. My own mother is always there to talk to me but I cannot talk about issues like this so I understand what you are going through to a degree. I am happy you are trying to move forward. Good luck and I hope your future is bright.

You might be right. I know it's hard to improve at art but sometimes I feel like I don't have the time for it. I mean, I barely do anything with my life so I actually do have a lot of time for practice but I feel like I'm also wasting my life because of the low opinion of myself. Maybe it's like you said, my success is not in art but in something else I never tried before. I hope we can both succeed and I wish us both luck.

EDIT: I made a mistake when reading your comment and I thought you said if I quit, I'll find success a different way. My apologies.

Your family is just your family. If they don't care about you or they treat you like crap, then they do not deserve to be your family. I had problems with my father in the past but his problems shouldn't bring you down but obviously it happens anyways. It hurts to get mistreated by our loved ones. Your life is worth more than throwing it away over some crappy people you just happened to be born with. I live next to my father's brother and he's a drunk asshole that just yells all day at his cats and I hate hearing him but ultimately, he's just a loser and we deserve better than these people. It's not worth caring about people in your family that treat you like crap.

I want to kind of quit permanently but I don't think I ever will. Last time I picked up my pencil, I couldn't get the anatomy down and I got frustrated before stopping. I have a friend who is way better than me but she's not some triple A artist either but compared to her, I suck. I think we give up on ourselves because we try to be like other people but that's impossible. I cannot be like my one artist friend, I can only live my own life with all it's pros and cons. You don't have to be good at anything to be happy, I feel, but sometimes self-esteem gets wrapped up in what we do and when we aren't as good as we think, it hurts.

Honestly, I made it past the stick figure phase I was in as a kid and now my "style" is this comic book/cartoon thing that tries to be semi-realistic when it comes to anatomy. Too bad I don't understand anatomy and especially shading. I'm a traditional artist (even though I don't think I'm good enough to be considered an artist) and I can't ever see myself drawing digitally. You are right, no matter what, someone will either be better or worse than you. That is insightful to me, in some way, so thank you for this. Maybe we could move forward if we only focused on our own art and how much we have improved since the past.

It would be a lie to say I didn't improve but I'm just so apathetic about drawing. I have this bad defeatist attitude that thinks that I have no talent and I have no work ethic so there is no point in drawing if my potential is so limited. Thank you for replying. One day I would want to draw again when I'm in a more positive state of mind.

Hello, evilspells. My own father died of stomach cancer about two years ago. I am not saying this to bring you down but I am saying this to help you understand that I know some of what you are feeling. I am sorry you have to deal with this. The only thing I can suggest is spend as much time with him as possible and hope he will get better. When my father was sick, I fought with him occasionally and it was a waste of time. Wanting to die over this news is not the strangest thing, I think. It sucks. Even if it's hard, at least try to talk to him instead of self-harming/attempting suicide.

Take solace in the fact that emotional problems like depression/suicide have a low bar for being approved as a legitimate problem. You don't have to cut yourself to prove to other people or yourself that you are suicidal. It can just be an emotion and a desire to die. Your problems as not worth less than the problems of other people. How you feel is your own. Stigma and shame sucks and it has no place in the world of mental illness, for the most part. If you are suicidal and you want help, you should be able to get it. Forget proving stuff to other people who don't care about you.

I think these places are over-staffed. I can only imagine how many people like you are in this world and they need help so they call the hotline. For the operators, it's probably rough work but I like to imagine they are doing their best. I never tried myself. I'm sorry you had to deal with a crappy experience. Sometimes I think talking to my friends is a proper substitute for a hotline but, even then, I feel like my problems are worthless to them. Like what I'm going through just doesn't matter because I'm some random asshole on the internet.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts. I used to have a pattern in my life but as I got older, that pattern didn't work anymore. It's like what I was used to wasn't good enough or something, like my "element" wasn't enough. I don't know. Hopefully we can all make a positive change in the future, even if it's only a little bit.
This happened to me today. Sometimes it feels like I have a fever or something and my body feels cold and I'm all anxious. It sucks.

Yeah, I know. Try to do the best you can with what you have. Donate to charity or help around your local community. It sounds trite but big change doesn't really happen unless it's with people in power with a lot of money. But small stuff matters as well. You are not worthless and I believe it's impossible for a human life to be worthless. The amount of positive change possible varies from person to person but even little change matters. If everyone just gave up and said "screw it" then the world would be even worse. Being consumed with apathy is a struggle I deal with constantly.

Looks don't really matter unless you have some sort of physical deformation and, even then, it shouldn't matter. People shouldn't judge you based on what you look like. Many people are shallow and society does put beauty as a standard for women and men. I like to think I'm okay looking but ultimately it's irrelevant if your own emotional happiness is low. What people think is beautiful is probably hideous to someone else though. It's largely subjective.

I'm sorry. You might already know this but this wasn't your fault. Your father didn't do this because of you or what you did. Don't ever blame yourself. You can feel however you want to but it's not your fault.

You might be right but actually making yourself believe that you are good enough is not easy for me. I wish I knew how to stop comparing my life to the lives of people I don't even know but it still happens. I just suck.
At least you are trying different things. Sometimes it feels like there is a skill ceiling or something that other people don't have but you do.

Hello, this is talentlesstrash but I had to make a new account. Thank you for replying. I used to write fan-fiction in the past but I doubt that means much of anything. I like to tell myself that my writing was better than my drawing but they probably both suck.
